_readme: Prices for the system configurator. Edit this file only - no HTML or JS changes needed.
Set "enabled": true once real prices are filled in. While it is false the site shows no
prices at all, but the quote list and the request form still work.
'bases' is the price of the empty chassis for each size. 'modules' is the price per module,
counted once per module regardless of how many slots it occupies.
Keys in 'modules' must match the module names used by the configurator exactly.
